'''Kray'geen T'ihar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bundim]], T'ihar took over the Alliance network several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during a time of crisis and built up the Alliance's military and economic resources. Following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of the planet and the [[Battle of Heg]], T'ihar took command of the Alliance remnants, vowing to learn from their previous mistakes.
